```plato

// A piecewise cubic Hermite spline in space: interpolates every point with an
// explicit tangent per point (same count as Points)
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cubic_Hermite_spline).
type HermiteSpline3D
    implements ICurve3D
{
    Points: Array<Point3D>;
    Tangents: Array<Vector3D>;
    Closed: Boolean;
}
```
